description: Declared mutants of camera phases, views of no camera, full-screen and depth-only passes, pass reads and the RP-3 assertion (render-pipeline declaration section 14, v8-arch-gyo2-render-a2; 判定 P1 to P9; render RD-4, RD-11, RD-12; RP-3). One per independently wrong decision (tests/common/mutation/README.md, criteria 1 to 3 and 9). The gf-, gd- and gt- mutants need a GPU (label gpu); gt-unwritten-not-asserted runs the skipped death case with --no-skip. Not added (with the reason): ui_render's pass in Overlay (no Engine module queues a PostProcess pass yet, so Overlay and PostProcess draw alike until A4's tonemapping; the phases' order is cp-phase-order-reversed); a full-screen pass's colour replaced, not blended (every test shader writes alpha 1, which blends the same); the depth format picked for drawing and sampling (every driver tried takes D32_FLOAT for both); a 3D pass's depth target of another size and a pass on a target of the wrong kind (Programmer Errors asserted, not tested: no guard against misuse, AGENTS section 3); the shader tool's --function (the tool is a separate host build; a table defined as EmbeddedShaders would not link with the Plugin's, so the test executable's link guards it).
